verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 36% of the time (354 touches) vs 41% at placebo levels (-4 pts, p=0.1133).
Magnet beta: fix -0.0011 (t=-0.09) vs placebo 0.0021 (t=0.2). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
